verdicts.reason: A shrinks the 'Enter Now' CTA and LIMITED badge into an illegible, pill-sized cluster under the shoe, so the action is effectively lost; the subcopy is also crammed against the right edge. B keeps a readable lime CTA and badge, but the right side is cramped: the shoe is shrunk to an icon wedged against the badge, and the three-line subcopy is tiny and squeezed between the headline and the CTA.
